description: Renders a single comment thread with its anchor label and open/resolved status. Shows a collapsed preview when resolved or expanded entries with author and time, inline edit and reply composers, and resolve, reopen, and delete actions.

parameters.name: Participants
parameters.description: Optional participant palette used to color this thread and its entries by author.

parameters.name: CanDeleteOwnComments
parameters.description: Whether the current user can resolve or reopen threads.

parameters.name: CanResolve
parameters.description: Whether the current user can add replies.

parameters.name: CollapseResolved
parameters.description: Whether a comment operation is currently running.

parameters.name: CurrentAuthorId
parameters.description: Whether the current user can delete comment threads they own.

parameters.name: IsBusy
parameters.description: Current author identifier used for ownership checks.

parameters.name: MentionProvider
parameters.description: Whether resolved threads are collapsed by default.

parameters.name: OnDelete
parameters.description: Raised when the thread should be reopened.

parameters.name: OnEdit
parameters.description: Raised when a reply is submitted.

parameters.name: OnReopen
parameters.description: Raised when the thread should be resolved.

parameters.name: OnReply
parameters.description: Raised when the thread is selected.

parameters.name: OnResolve
parameters.description: Raised when an existing entry is edited.

parameters.name: OnSelect
parameters.description: Optional mention provider reused by the reply composer.
